name: Shadow of the Void triggers from melee attacks above 40 Insanity (#9528)
contract: Shadow of the Void 574318: 'While above 40 Insanity, melee attacks and abilities trigger Shadow of the Void',
the 8 sec buff 300277 (+9% Shadow damage done). 574318 has a spell_proc row and aura_ascension_cultist_event,
whose check requires damage dealt, a melee attack and more than 40 stacks of Insanity 500706. Expected: a
Cultist who knows the talent and holds 50 Insanity gains 300277 within a few auto attacks on a target; a
control Cultist with the same Insanity and swings but without the talent never does.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the tester knows Shadow of the Void
SETUP: the tester holds more than 40 Insanity
SETUP: no Shadow of the Void buff yet
the tester's auto attacks deal damage
the control's auto attacks deal damage
Insanity is still above 40 while swinging
DISCRIMINATING: a damaging melee attack above 40 Insanity triggers 300277
the control without the talent has no Shadow of the Void
